origin: SEG Phase 4-F.1 Weak Area Intelligence Layer. Deterministic pipeline: Wrong Question → topicId → Repeated Errors → Weak Topic → Recommended Action. No Dashboard mutation; no new topics; no guessed mappings. Thresholds are calibration-ready.

config.notes: Thresholds are calibration-ready; change only with paired outcome data and review note (see CALIBRATION_LAYER.md).

recommendedActions.description: Review the topic's management/diagnostic algorithm from the global layer.
Read the topic's book summary (Tintinalli/Rosen) via book-topic-mapping.
Solve related Qbank questions for the same topicId (HAS_QUESTIONS).

inputs.questionPerformance: Runtime attempts: { questionId, correct } — Qbank history or in-session attempts; unmapped questions are ignored, never guessed.

outputs.weakAreas: Array of { topicId, topicName, system, errorCount, totalAttempts, accuracy, isWeak, recommendedActions, reason } sorted by errorCount → accuracy → topicId

invariants: Zero new topics; zero book/Qbank/Dashboard/engine edits in this phase; unmapped questions stay out of graph.
